findings.finding: PAN-N1/PAN-N3 overquestion=true is supported only for the currently read bodies, and PAN-C2 is supported only for the exact equal-output fixture. PAN-N4 C currently stores false despite actual necessity being unjudgeable.

findings.finding: PAN-C1's field is an environment option while its question asks desired preservation. The official test verifies the option-output contrast, while the goal-to-command mapping is investigator construction.
findings.acceptance: Retain technical_pair_denominator=true but strict_effect_denominator=false. Conditional actionability is restricted to an owner able to identify the constructed preserve/omit goal. No observation of actual choice exists.
findings.would_change: A same-predicate natural request with explicit owner goal, original inputs, and independent goal-preserving output would strengthen the policy claim.

findings.finding: All 36 natural score rows remain unjudgeable, avoiding promotion of an inspection step or unimplemented filter/AST enhancement into complete-goal correctness. PAN-N1's multi-section expansion and PAN-N3's unpinned development target remain excluded from strict comparison.
findings.acceptance: Root tables may describe next actions separately, but must not turn them into known complete conversions or a nonzero strict-effect denominator.
findings.would_change: Recovered opening requests, exact target versions/inputs, and complete independently checked outcomes for both field values would permit stronger judgments.

findings.finding: N2 comments separate other-field disclosures, maintainer advice/fix reports, and different goals. The event ledger contains 19 records but only 13 follow-up utterances; 2 rows are empty-collection observations.
findings.acceptance: Use record-type counts. Do not equate comments, closures, or a maintainer's tentative fix with independently observed success of the frozen policies.
findings.would_change: A subsequent OP report tied to an exact fixed version and the original font criteria would add outcome evidence, still not a randomized question effect.

findings.finding: The 12 known-value Pandoc control rows, or 24 combined-project rows, are scenario inventory counts. They need not equal a denominator explicitly restricted to completing actions. Positive-control A holds remain observable holds under both known values and nonresponse.
findings.acceptance: Separate scenario counts, status-classification availability, complete-goal correctness, and strict causal-effect eligibility. If completion_judgment_denominator excludes holds at no_answer, apply the same definition to value1/value2 holds, or document a different criterion-availability definition consistently.
findings.would_change: Root data dictionary and arithmetic that consistently map every row to these distinct denominators resolve this ambiguity.

findings.finding: Source work IDs have no counted duplicates, and failures/comments/repeated manual versions do not inflate the 20 declared works. Three code works are outside the four required minimum categories.
